tagline: Web design, built for what's next.
heroTitle: Websites engineered to move your business forward.
heroSubtitle: I design and build fast, modern, custom websites — then keep them running smoothly. Design, development, and bug-fixing, all under one roof.
aboutText: I'm a web designer focused on building fast, modern, custom websites for small businesses and ambitious brands. Full bio coming soon — for now, reach out and let's talk about your project.

services.title: Website Design
services.description: Custom, on-brand designs built from scratch — no generic templates. Every layout is designed around your business and your customers.

services.title: Website Development
services.description: Fast, responsive, production-ready builds using modern tools, from simple presentation sites to fully custom, animated experiences.

services.title: Redesigns & Refreshes
services.description: Got a site that feels outdated or isn't converting? I'll rebuild it with a modern look, better structure, and improved performance.

services.title: Bug Fixes & Troubleshooting
services.description: Broken layouts, form issues, slow load times, weird bugs — I dig in, find the root cause, and fix it properly.

services.title: Ongoing Maintenance
services.description: Updates, small changes, monitoring, and quick turnarounds so your site keeps running smoothly long after launch.

services.title: Let's figure it out together
services.description: Not sure exactly what you need? If it's design-related, chances are we can work it out together — get in touch and let's talk.

pricing.name: Spark
